original_idea: 我想研究利用机器学习或深度学习模型，基于公开 ICU 临床数据预测患者发生急性肾损伤的风险。请分析目前是否已经有类似研究、已有研究主要采用哪些方法、可能存在什么研究差异，以及这个想法在数据、方法、算力和验证方面是否具有可行性。

evidence.quote: Across the 47 included studies, models including LR, RF, XGBoost, and SVM were the most commonly used.
Feature selection methods varied, with LASSO and expert-driven approaches being the most common.
The variables representing AIP and AKI were selected based on the intersection of results from LASSO regression and the Boruta algorithm.
We constructed 13 models to predict AKI occurrence in critically ill patients, including XGBoost, Adaboost, CatBoost, Bagging, SVM, KNN, Random Forest and ANN, as shown in Figure .
